motion: Slow push-in on the Explorer standing on the shoreline at dusk, gentle waves lapping the rocks, lantern flame flickering, low sun glittering on the water.
Close-up of the lantern in the Explorer's hand, flame breathing softly, then the camera drifts up past the shoulder toward the glowing horizon.
The Explorer walks along the shore toward a small moored sailboat, lantern swinging gently, camera tracking from behind.
The Explorer steps into the small sailboat, pushes off from the rocks with an oar, the sail fills with wind and the boat glides away from shore.
The sailboat glides over calm dark water, sail full, lantern glow reflecting in the gentle wake, camera slowly circling behind.
Close view of the Explorer at the tiller, hand adjusting it, lantern glowing beside, stars above, the sea moving past.
The boat heels as it tacks across the wind, the boom swings over, spray flies, the Explorer leans into the turn holding the lantern steady.
The boat sails steadily toward a far mountain as the first dawn light spreads, camera pulling back and rising to show the zigzag wake across the sea.
The boat reaches a rocky shore, the Explorer climbs out onto the rocks and looks up at the tall mountain ahead.

The Explorer climbs the rocky slope with the lantern raised; the camera rises toward the mountain's far edge, which looks smooth from afar but resolves into a jagged fractal of repeating shards as it gets closer.
The Explorer reaches the mountain edge and raises the lantern; small cracks in the rock light up with faint teal glow one after another.
The Explorer runs a gloved hand across the rock, teal veins glowing and spreading beneath the surface as dust falls away.
The Explorer wedges the lantern against a crack and pries the rock apart, teal and amber light pours out as the crack widens.
The camera pushes through the opened crack into a hidden luminous world of waterfalls, glowing bridges and floating light, the Explorer's silhouette in the foreground.
A small rough raft on a beach transforms step by step into a proper small sailboat, planks and mast rising as if time-lapsed.
The small sailboat grows and transforms step by step into a large handsome sailing ship, sails unfurling, as if time-lapsed.
The Explorer steps out onto the thin glowing teal bridge over the misty chasm, wind tugging at the coat, lantern flaring brighter with each step.
Mid-bridge, the Explorer keeps walking with the lantern held out, mist swirling in the chasm below, bright peak ahead.
The Explorer reaches the far side and gazes at the highest peak lit by sunrise, camera rising slowly.
Night on a high ridge, the Explorer sits by the lantern, its flame breathing steadily and warm, stars wheeling slowly above.
A strong gust of wind and snow hits the ridge, the lantern flame gutters almost out, the Explorer cups it with both hands to shield it.
Small glowing lanterns appear one by one along the ridge and below, other travellers arriving, and the Explorer's own flame rekindles strong and warm.
Dawn at the summit, the camera slowly orbits the Explorer standing with the lantern raised, the glowing bud of light on the horizon.
Slow push toward the horizon over the misty valleys as the sun climbs, golden light spreading across the ranges.
The Explorer stands at the summit edge looking at the vast horizon, hesitates with the lantern lowered, then slowly lifts it again.
The lantern is raised high and the bud of light on the horizon opens like a flower in a burst of golden and teal light, the camera cranes up and pulls back to reveal the whole glowing landscape.
